title: Bearings, Distances and 3D Problems
seo_title: Bearings and Distances – SSS 2 Mathematics Worksheets with Answers (NERDC)
standard_text: Solve problems on bearings and distances in two and three dimensions using Pythagoras, trigonometric ratios and the sine and cosine rules. (summary of the NERDC SSS 2 Mathematics curriculum)
meta_desc: Free SSS 2 maths worksheets on bearings and distances: journeys on bearings, distances north and east, and problems in three dimensions. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Draw the north line at every point
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Sketch the journey with a north line at each turning point.
  • Use alternate angles to find the angle inside the triangle.
  • In 3D, find a right-angled triangle that contains the length you want.

Examples

Example

Cuboid 3 × 4 × 12

√(9 + 16 + 144)

Answer: Diagonal 13

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Forgetting the north line at the second pointDraw one at every point.
Using a non-right-angled triangle with SOH CAH TOAUse the sine or cosine rule.
Mixing up the 3D triangleDraw it separately.
